Looking for a quick and effective arm and shoulder workout? Join me for this 10-minute dumbbell workout for women over 50 to help build strength, develop muscle, and achieve stronger, more toned-looking arms!
In this short upper-body strength workout, we'll use two sets of dumbbells: one lighter set and one heavier set. We'll begin with lighter weights to warm up, move to heavier dumbbells to challenge our muscles and build strength, then finish with body weight only for muscular endurance. This combination helps us work the biceps, triceps, shoulders, and upper back in just 10 minutes.
